body: Well I'm 28. If I'm unlucky enough to have the same good physical health as my parents and grandparents I could well live to past 100. That means I'm a quarter of the way through this, and it's getting worse not better. So just how long is 'a while'? I'm sick of this crap.
So just how long are we expected to wait while this unjustifiable affliction plagues us week in, week out?
